OAT DESKTOP UNSIGNED BUILD NOTICE

The Windows installer in this release does not have an Authenticode signature.
The macOS app uses only a certificate-free ad-hoc signature so it can run on
Apple Silicon. It has no Apple Developer ID identity and has not been notarized
by Apple.

Before installing, verify the file against SHA256SUMS.txt and the GitHub
Artifact Attestation attached to the repository build. Windows may display an
Unknown publisher or SmartScreen warning. macOS may require System Settings >
Privacy & Security > Open Anyway.

OAT DESKTOP 未签名构建说明

本 Release 中的 Windows 安装程序没有 Authenticode 签名；macOS 应用仅使用不含
开发者身份、无需证书的 ad-hoc 签名，以保证 Apple Silicon 可以运行。它没有
Apple Developer ID 身份，也没有经过 Apple 公证。安装前请核对 SHA256SUMS.txt
并验证 GitHub Artifact Attestation。Windows 可能显示“未知发布者”或 SmartScreen
警告；macOS 可能需要在“系统设置 > 隐私与安全性”中选择“仍要打开”。
